dino.purpose: Frozen new component model/scorer on the original seen full1 failure scene. Only first NAV parameter chosen by model; all native goals/physical guards unchanged. New source, one attempt, no fit or retry.
dino.research_threebox_admission: separate CPU scene compile only; frozen A light/box20, B middle/.5, C heavy/1 and40cm platform are not this native1kg episode
dino.limits: Native safety failure stops; source histories may be reinitialized per zyh protocol, physical task world and motor delay queue may not reset; no automatic retries
dino.source_router: Original Machine starts at registered approach pose, native startup/PUSH entry/NN. New soft-failure router retires actual PUSH authority before next issued command, retains native hard guards, reuses native balance/collision and protected reference math.
dino.auxiliary_calibration_initial_pose_adjus: Original zyh settle may adjust pose only in its separate calibration world; not task-world recovery, never a training episode
dino.review_scope: FULL continuous A failure / B step /40cm high platform / C bridge / ROBOT CROSSING required
dino.initialization: Before FIRST main physics step, after original separate auxiliary calibration: only robot leg positions/height from native reference_stance; arm native safe compact waypoint. No failed state, velocity, force, queue or policy history copied. Native six-second measured startup and physical PushEntry remain unchanged. Recovery NEVER writes physical state.
dino.failure: Native hard flags first; motion_ready+legal hand contact60ms with signed X advance<2mm, not near goal; labels this attempt only, never global immovability.
dino.balance_COM_reference: Native whole-body QP unchanged; independent FK uses actual arm and desired leg posture, avoiding double COM shift from a not-yet-retracted arm.
dino.revision_reason: New independent diagnostic version: same frozen skill weights and original hard guards, opt-in exact before-raise B contact capsule plus actual onboard/full-state video. One launch only; old B root remains read-only.
dino.unload_control: Original Kp/Kd retained. Piecewise-affine rate/accel/PD/FF intersection; actual motor PD velocity target ZERO during unload, distinct from issued position-reference derivative. Native gravity FF replaces original spring gravity-support torque proportionally to reference reconciliation; no state/reference jump or gain bypass.
dino.retreat: Signed real box-face gap velocity servo clip(2*(gap-.645),-.05,+.05), full measured internal COM velocity Jcom*dq-baseVx mapped into UNCHANGED native COM task; actual .18m/.15mps envelopes unchanged. Overshoot commands bounded return, not zero-control deadzone.
dino.stow_trajectory: Native reverse safe approach, final waypoint replaced by interior compact [0,.18,-.18,0,0,0]. Synchronized quintic maxnominal .40rad/s/.80rad/s²; actual .45/1 and original soft+.01 margins unchanged.
dino.support_reference: Once all actualfeet>=12N and horizontal feet speed<.03 continuously.1s, capture current measured footXYZ as CONTROL anchors only. No physical pose/force/queue/history write. Capture/hold gates unchanged.

navigation.arrival_capture: After unchanged native NAV1s hold and actual base speed<.08 (native Finish arm-brake domain), bumpless original QP takeover with original foot-Z .022 references. No arm unfolding. Must achieve actual foot>=12N, speed<.02, hand unloaded and capture .2s after minimum .5s braking, before4s compact verification+5s hold. All original hard guards remain.
navigation.native_arrival_balance: Restore original Finish four-foot planned support (NOT measured force spoof) and stance_posture_weight .3 with original stance_delay .5/stance_seconds2/stance_joints interpolation. Actual>=12N foot capture, .15mps/.18m envelope and hard guards unchanged. Existing PUSH recovery retains measured-contact plan and postureweight0.
navigation.arrival_two_phase: Original native four-foot stance .3 cost for .5+2s normalization; only after actual loaded stationary support captured, weight0 for measured real gap relocation. Never fake contact/pose, no changed final thresholds.

causal_model_policy.scope: one actual three-candidate NAV_STEP parameter; rest native nominal
